text: 📱 Android Apps On iPhone Andarium can now run APK files on an iPhone by launching a virtual Android 17 environment. This makes it possible to try apps that are unavailable in the App Store, including some banking apps, depending on compatibility. ✔️ Virtual Android 17 runs directly on iPhone ✔️ Internet, camera, and microphone access are available ✔️ VPN must be disabled for Andarium to work properly 👉 Link 👈 App support depends on each APK, so compatibility may vary. 💻 @program

📱 OpenCode Comes To Smartphones OpenCode is now available on smartphones, letting you manage sessions and agents remotely while they keep running on your PC. Connect remote access with a QR code and continue working from your phone when you leave the computer. ✔️ Monitor the AI agent in real time ✔️ Send new tasks and approve or reject actions ✔️ Dictate explanations and send images ✔️ Continue active sessions from your phone 👉 Link 👈 Scan the QR code to connect your phone and keep control of OpenCode sessions from anywhere. 💻 @program

🐺 Wolfenstein 3 Is Officially In Development Wolfenstein 3 has officially entered development. Xbox head Asha Sharma confirmed the news and shared an excerpt from the new game's script.
